svg.title: Leech lifting in one exact slice, and the heights of all blocks
svg.desc: Left: a globe with twelve touching caps of true size. Three lifted caps sit around the removed owner direction u and three around minus u; six auxiliary caps lie on the equator. Right: a scale of the angle each kind of block makes with the 24-dimensional Leech space.
